d: Great square of Antioch magnificently adorned with military trophies, composed of signs, weapons and other remains of barbarians surpassed. Imperial throne on one side. Bridge over the river Oronte, which divides the aforementioned city. From here from the river, Hadrian on triumphal chariot led by Schiavi, Aquilio, Guards and People. Beyond the river, Farnaspe and Osroa, with followers of Parties, leading gifts to present to Hadrian, which, to the sound of cheerful symphony, descends from the chario.
Apartments for Emirena in the imperial palace. Aquilio, then Emirena.

Courtyards of the imperial palace with a view interrupted by a part of the same that underlies fire. Night. Osroa from the palace with face on the right and naked sword on the left, followed by Fires Parties, then Farnaspe.
Sabina, then Aquilio, then Adriano, all with Séguito.
Farnaspe chained between Roman guards, and Emirena.
Gallery in Adriano's apartments corresponding to several toilets. Emirena and Sabina.
Wood adjacent to royal gardens, emirena, Sabina and Farnaspe.
Osroa in Roman dress with bare sword from the road drawn by Sabina, and Farnaspe; in the separate Emirena.
Farnaspe, Hadrian with bare sword and Guards from the aforementioned road. Osroa and Emirena aside.
Earthly room with chairs. Sabina and Aquilio.

Magnificent place of the imperial palace. Stairs for which you go down to the slopes of the Oronte. View of the countryside and gardens on the opposite bank. Sabina and Aquilio, with Séguito, who walk towards the ships, and Hadrian with numerous accompaniment.
